itemDesc: A simple mine that is placed under terrain and fitted with a pressure-sensitive plate to detonate under the weight of heavy vehicles. Mines are visible to friendlies and enemies on foot.
This heavy-duty explosive device is designed to deal significant damage to fortified structures and stationary vehicles.
Used to construct Barbed Wire defenses.
The Binoculars (also known as "Binos") is a utility item used to increase the player's viewing distance.
Anti-infantry mine that deliver a fatal payload to unsuspecting soldiers.
When attached to a Gas Mask, this filter provides fresh air to the wearer.

This unique demolition tool is a long, metal tube packed with explosives. The Hydra’s Whisper is designed to destroy out-of-reach movement impairing structures and detonate any mines along the length of the tube.
Allows receiving map intelligence reports on detected airborne targets.
Used to construct Metal Beam defenses.
A paratrooper's basic kit. Includes minimal survival gear to improve weight distribution and account for parachutes.
Allows receiving map intelligence reports on detected ground, naval, and air targets.
Automatically gathers map intel periodically when equipped.
The Sandbag is a Large Material used to build sandbags structures. Due to being a large item, players can only carry one at a time.
